repos.name: daytonaio/daytona
repos.description: Daytona is a Secure and Elastic Infrastructure for Running AI-Generated Code
repos.one_liner: A secure and elastic development environment infrastructure designed for running AI-generated code.
bullets: Built on a containerized architecture that automates the provisioning of standardized dev environments.
Provides a centralized control plane to manage development infrastructure across local, cloud, and self-hosted environments.
Optimized for AI-driven workflows, ensuring that LLM-generated code is executed in isolated, secure, and reproducible sandboxes.
Enables teams to scale development resources elastically, reducing onboarding time and environment drift.

repos.name: irinabuht12-oss/google-meta-ads-ga4-mcp
repos.description: MCP server for Google Ads, Meta Ads & GA4 — works with ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, n8n, Windsurf & more. 250+ tools for campaign management, analytics & optimization.
repos.one_liner: An MCP server providing over 250 tools for managing and analyzing Google Ads, Meta Ads, and GA4 data.
bullets: Implements the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to bridge LLMs like Claude and ChatGPT with marketing data APIs.
Supports complex campaign management, real-time analytics retrieval, and automated optimization tasks.
Integrates directly into AI-native IDEs like Cursor and Windsurf, or automation platforms like n8n.
Ideal for marketing quants and growth engineers looking to automate performance reporting and ad spend optimization.
repos.img_alt: Google + Meta Ads in one MCP

repos.name: MetaMask-AI/metamask-desktop
repos.description: 🌐 🔌 The MetaMask desktop app enables browsing Ethereum blockchain enabled websites
repos.one_liner: A native desktop application for MetaMask, bringing Ethereum wallet functionality outside the browser environment.
bullets: Built as a standalone desktop client to enhance security and performance for Web3 interactions.
Provides a dedicated interface for managing digital assets, NFTs, and decentralized application (dApp) connections.
Reduces reliance on browser-based extensions, offering a more robust environment for high-frequency DeFi users.
Facilitates seamless blockchain-enabled browsing and transaction signing across desktop operating systems.

repos.name: SegFault42/HeliosGen
repos.description: 🏆 Self Hosted Gen AI platform. Free alternative to Higgsfield, OpenArt, Freepik....
repos.one_liner: A self-hosted generative AI platform serving as an open-source alternative to commercial image generation services.
bullets: Utilizes a modular backend architecture capable of running various diffusion models locally or on private cloud infrastructure.
Provides a comprehensive UI for prompt engineering, model management, and high-quality asset generation.
Focuses on data privacy and cost-efficiency by eliminating per-generation fees associated with proprietary SaaS platforms.
Suitable for developers building custom AI-driven creative pipelines or internal enterprise design tools.

repos.name: daffainfo/vol-rs
repos.description: Volatility 3 ported to Rust. Same output, much faster.
repos.one_liner: A high-performance Rust port of the Volatility 3 memory forensics framework.
bullets: Leverages Rust's memory safety and concurrency primitives to achieve significant speed improvements over the original Python implementation.
Maintains compatibility with existing Volatility 3 plugins and output formats for seamless integration into security workflows.
Designed for deep-dive memory analysis, incident response, and malware investigation.
Provides a critical tool for security researchers and forensic analysts dealing with large-scale memory dumps.
